title: ai-governance-watch source list
description: Schema for sources/literature-watch.yaml — the single source-of-truth URL list the watch pipeline crawls. Every watched URL must sit on the domain allowlist (Appendix E hardening).

version.description: Schema version. Bump only on a breaking shape change.

paused.description: Global maintenance switch. When true the routine runs in dry-run mode and produces logs only, no PRs.

user_agent.description: User-Agent sent on every fetch. Must identify the project and a contact (Appendix E).

cadence.description: Crawl cadence. The routine batches all due sources into one run.

adapter.description: Which adapter fetches and extracts this target.

allowlisted_url.description: HTTPS URL on the domain allowlist. Adding a new domain is a deliberate, reviewed schema change.

note.description: Optional human note on what this target covers.

id.description: Stable machine id. Used in branch names, labels, lock-free PR search, and the reference frontmatter.

title.description: Full title of the standard or body of work.

reference_file.description: The memory-mirror/ file this source maintains. Exactly one per source.

enabled.description: If false, the source is scoped but not yet crawled (planned state).

state.description: Rollout state, mirrors the README source-coverage table.

license.description: Human-readable license/reuse status of the source content (e.g. 'U.S. Government work — public domain', 'CC BY-NC-SA 4.0', 'ISO copyright — proprietary').

reproduction.description: Reproduction policy tier the library applies to this source. Governs how much of the source may be reproduced on a public page (vs. paraphrased in our own words).
